description: Change the title, details, place, date, time or theme of an event invite made with status_create_event. Send eventId, editKey and only the fields to change. The invite link stays the same and guests see the change straight away. Does not change a date poll, the guest list or costs, and cannot cancel or delete the event.

date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out if the date is not set yet

details.description: Invite message for guests: what is happening, what to bring, dress code, cost per person

location.description: Venue name or address, e.g. "The Albion, Bristol"

theme.description: Visual style of the invite page: party, dinner, garden, sport, holiday, plain. Defaults to party

time.description: Start time as 24-hour HH:mm, local to timeZone, e.g. 19:30. Needs date

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for date and time, e.g. Europe/London (the default) or America/New_York

title.description: Event name shown at the top of the invite, e.g. "Sam's 30th" or "Book club dinner"

name: status_update_event

event.description: The event as guests see it

claimed.description: Whether the user has claimed the draft; guests can join only after this is true

date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD; null when not set

eventUrl.description: Where the host manages the event after claiming it

inviteUrl.description: Invite link for guests; works once the user has claimed the event

location.description: Venue name or address; null when not set

time.description: Start time as 24-hour HH:mm; null when not set

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for date and time; null when there is no date

title: Edit an event invite
